visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens inside a dark vehicle at night. A male driver with short black hair is visible from the side, wearing a dark green t-shirt. A smartphone is mounted on the car's center console, displaying a map and text interface. Outside, streetlights pass by in a blur against the night sky. (2) The scene shifts to the daytime car interior. Two men are seated in the front; the driver is eating a skewer while the passenger interacts with him. They both wear casual t-shirts and seatbelts. The lighting is bright and natural, coming through the windshield. (3) Inside a brightly lit convenience store, the camera focuses on shelves stocked with various beverages and canned goods. A hand reaches out to grab several packs of red canned porridge. The man stacks about a dozen cans in his arms, smiling broadly at the camera. (4) The camera shows a smartphone screen displaying a live-streamed map with a large crowd icon and a video feed of people walking. Hands are seen navigating the phone interface, pointing at a specific location on the map. (5) On an outdoor street during a sunny day, the car's trunk is open, revealing stacks of red canned porridge. The two men stand by the car, handing the cans to a passing crowd of pilgrims. The pilgrims wear bright red or orange hats, carry large backpacks, and many wear face masks. (6) A religious palanquin, adorned with red and gold fabric, is carried through the street by several people wearing yellow uniforms. A large crowd follows behind it, including police officers in high-visibility vests. The environment is a typical suburban street with utility poles and low-rise buildings.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents the creators' journey to participate in the Baishatun Mazu Pilgrimage. It shows them preparing by buying 60 portions of canned porridge and then distributing them to the pilgrims on the street as an act of kindness and devotion. The video conveys a sense of community, religious fulfillment, and altruism.
